The program Earth and moon -The UK Banking Reform Act requires the separation of HBEU’s UK retail and SME operations into 
ring fenced bank (the RFB). The main aim of the project was to separate out the ring fence (RFB) and NRFB bank. This was a 
regulatory change mandated by the UK government. 
All RBWM (Retail banking and Wealth Management) and CMB (Commercial Banking) will fall within the RFB except for few cases 
where the legislation explicitly prohibits. All GBM (Global Banking and Markets) will fall under Non-Ring Fence Bank. Worked with 
various teams like payments, authorization, clearing and settlement, core banking, reporting
